title: Reverse Integer
description: Given a signed 32-bit integer x, return x with its digits reversed. If reversing x causes the value to go outside the signed 32-bit integer range [-2^31, 2^31 - 1], then return 0.

steps.note: Initialize result accumulator rev = 0 for input x = 123.
Check loop condition: x (123) !== 0 is true.
Check overflow bounds: rev (0) is within [-214748364, 214748364].
Append popped digit to rev: rev = 0 * 10 + 3 = 3.
Check loop condition: x (12) !== 0 is true.
Check overflow bounds: rev (3) is within safe range.
Append popped digit to rev: rev = 3 * 10 + 2 = 32.
Check loop condition: x (1) !== 0 is true.
Check overflow bounds: rev (32) is within safe range.
Append popped digit to rev: rev = 32 * 10 + 1 = 321.
Check loop condition: x (0) !== 0 is false. Loop terminates.
